h3.text: C. Where you are: from a thread and from the bottom pill

annotations.text: My pick: A. The computer button at the top already stands for “my Macs”; today it only shows status. A makes it the place where each Mac’s abilities live: Screen works anywhere, Remote lights up when the Mac is nearby, New thread starts there. Home stays about threads. C1 (the thread’s ⋯ menu) is a cheap shortcut to add on top later.
The screen pictures need the Mac to send one still frame now and then; without them the cards are just name + buttons and it still works.
